title: Visa Fast-Track Agent
scenario: A travel agent guarantees visa approval for an extra cash fee.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Visa Fast-Track Agent: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Visa decisions are made by official authorities, not private guarantees.
